correctness.rationale: A direct symmetric-antitone proof gives F^3=F; recurrent NOR states biject to maximal independent sets of the canonical double cover; even covers split into two prisms and odd covers explicitly identify with the doubled prism. A three-letter local constraint has transfer characteristic polynomial t^5(t^2-t-1)(t^2+t+1), giving the exact formula for all n>=3. Separate complete-state and independent-set/transfer programs passed on their documented ranges, with no inference from finite tests to all n.

value.rationale: Circular ladders form a natural cubic graph family and the exact NOR fixed/primitive two-cycle populations are its natural dynamical invariants. The previously unenumerated complete orbit spectrum separates even and odd circumference by a graph-cover transition, has a closed Lucas/mod-three correction and a quantitative rarity exponent. This is not a relabelled elementary fixed-point result or a chosen finite tabulation.
